claim_boundary: Repository-owned preimplementation conformance/falsification oracle for #584. It does not accept ADR-039, grant authority, mutate lifecycle state, or assert that unavailable proposition/cardinality evidence exists.

exclusive_competition_evidence: same known proposition slot plus single_valued evidence without coexistence/hierarchical evidence
same known proposition slot plus persisted state_change_candidate/conflict relation with an exclusive basis
contract.affirmed_over_unknown: Within an established exclusive competition only, an affirmatively applicable candidate may dominate an unknown-temporal-basis alternative. The unknown remains admitted and labelled unknown.
contract.unknown_vs_unknown: No temporal dominance edge. Transaction time and observation time are forbidden as currentness tie-breaks. Preserve route-native/non-temporal ordering, then use the existing time-neutral deterministic digest only for a true residual tie.
contract.known_incompatible: Existing non-compensatory temporal demotion remains controlling under established current intent.
contract.two_applicable: #584 adds no applicable-vs-applicable winner. Existing relevance/evidence ordering remains controlling unless another independently governed rule applies.
contract.inferred_current: The first #584 profile does not apply affirmed-over-unknown dominance to query_cue_inference, even when the cue is high confidence and orders temporally.
contract.cycle_or_contradiction: Refuse the #584 dominance relation and preserve base order. Never break ambiguity with recency.
contract.hierarchy_boundary: Hierarchical/refinement compatibility must be positively established before it can be used as typed evidence. If the current interpreter cannot establish it, exclusivity is refused rather than guessed.
